title: Peteca
tagline: Strike it high. Keep it flying.
description: The hand shuttlecock game of Brazil. Strike the feathered peteca with the open palm over a high net on a sunlit beach: choose lob, drive, drop or smash, aim with your thumb and time it for a Perfect. Singles, doubles, Beach Rally and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap a pad to choose the stroke: Lob, Drive, Drop or Smash.
Tap when the peteca falls to the stroke's best height; the pad glows.
Where you tap in the pad sets the depth: left is short, right is deep.
Perfect strikes add spin; three in a row light the Power Palm.
Win the rally: land it in the rival's half or beat their reach.
